DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 講座に一人で参加したいです。二人一組の実習と書いてあるので、私が友人を誘ってから申し込む必要があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人参加で二人実習のため同行者確保が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to attend the course on my own. It says the practical session is done in pairs, so I'd like to know whether I need to invite a friend before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether someone attending alone must arrange a companion for the paired practice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この講座は一人でも申し込めます。当日、組を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can apply for this course on your own. We'll assign the pairs on the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら一人で申し込みたいです。知らない参加者と組むことは大丈夫ですが、先にどんな作業を分けるのか知っておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人申込を希望し組相手は問題なく作業分担を知りたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: In that case, I'd like to apply on my own. I'm comfortable pairing up with someone I don't know, but I'd like to know beforehand how the tasks will be divided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you wish to apply alone, have no problem with an unfamiliar partner, and want to know the division of tasks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一人が組み立て、もう一人が説明を読む実習です。途中で役割を替えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: One person assembles the item while the other reads the instructions. You'll swap roles partway through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。読む係だけで最後まで終えるのでなく、組み立ても経験できるのですね。両方やってみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 役割交代で読解組立両方経験できると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. So I won't just read the instructions until the end; I'll also get to try assembling it. I'd like to try both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that swapping roles lets you experience both reading and assembly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。読む時に難しい文字があれば講師へ質問できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. If you encounter difficult characters when reading, you can ask the instructor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。相手が読めるから全部任せるのではなく、自分の番には質問しながら読んでみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 難字は講師質問で相手任せにせず自分も読むと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Rather than leaving everything to my partner because they can read it, I'll try reading on my turn and ask questions as needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll ask the instructor about difficult characters and read on your own turn rather than relying entirely on your partner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申込みは一人分です。ご希望の回をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please apply for one person. Write down the session you would like to attend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この回に一人で申し込みます。二人分の席を取らず、当日の組と役割交代は案内を聞いて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望回へ一人分申込し二席取らず当日組役割を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll apply for this session for one person. I won't reserve two seats, and on the day I'll listen to the guidance to confirm my pair and the role changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll apply for one person for your chosen session, reserve no second seat, and confirm the pairing and roles on the day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。当日は実習の案内をお聞きください。ご参加をお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please listen to the practical-session guidance on the day. We look forward to your participation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。診察の前にお伝えになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you would like to tell us before the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夫は遠くに住んでいて、今日は一緒に来られません。先生の説明を夫にも電話で聞いてもらいたいのですが、診察担当に相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遠方の夫は同伴できないため診察の説明を電話で一緒に聞けるか担当への相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My husband lives far away and cannot come with me today. I'd like him to hear the doctor's explanation by phone as well. Could you ask the person handling my consultation about this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask staff to consult the person in charge about having your distant husband, who cannot accompany you, hear the explanation together by phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へ伝えます。電話で参加できるかは担当の確認が必要です。ご主人には、お客様の診察の説明を聞いてもらうことを話してありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll pass your request to the person in charge. They need to confirm whether phone participation is possible. Have you told your husband that you want him to hear the explanation about your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、私から頼んで、夫も了承しています。帰宅後の生活について一緒に相談したいので、私だけで説明を聞き違えないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夫は了承済みで帰宅後の生活を相談するため自分一人の聞き違いが心配だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I asked him, and he has agreed. I want to discuss life after I return home with him, so I'm worried I might misunderstand the explanation if I listen alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your husband has agreed and that you're worried about mishearing alone because you want to discuss life after returning home together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 説明を一緒に聞きたいというご希望ですね。映像を使う通話や、説明の録音もご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you would like to hear the explanation together. Would you also like video calling or a recording of the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 映像も録音も希望していません。声だけでその場の説明を聞いてもらいたいです。使う前に、担当の返答を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 映像や録音ではなく声だけで聞く希望を伝え通話前に担当の返答を待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't want video or a recording. I'd just like him to hear the explanation live, by voice only. I'll wait for the person in charge to reply before using the phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want voice only, with no video or recording, and will wait for the person in charge's reply before calling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご主人が電話に出られる状態か、今のうちに確認できますか。診察の開始時刻はまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Could you check now whether your husband will be able to answer the phone? The consultation's start time has not yet been decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 短いメッセージで確認します。今すぐ電話をつないで待たせるのではなく、開始時刻はまだ分からないことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 夫が出られるかメッセージで確認し診察開始は未定で今から通話待機はさせないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check with a short message. Rather than connecting a call right now and making him wait, I'll also tell him that the start time is still unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll message your husband to check his availability, explain that the start time is undecided, and won't make him wait on a call now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。電話参加ができない場合は、説明を聞く時のメモの取り方などを担当へご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. If phone participation isn't possible, you can ask the person in charge about ways to take notes while listening to the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 電話が難しければ、説明をメモする方法を相談します。後で夫に話せるよう、分からなかった点は診察中に質問したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話参加が不可なら説明のメモ方法を相談し不明点は診察中に質問して後で夫へ伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: If a phone call isn't possible, I'll ask about how to take notes on the explanation. I'd like to ask about anything I don't understand during the consultation so I can tell my husband later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply that if phone participation isn't possible, you'll ask about note-taking and clarify anything unclear during the consultation so you can tell your husband afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご家族の了承があり、映像や録音を使わず声だけで説明を聞いてもらいたい、という希望を担当へ伝えます。電話参加はまだ決まっていませんので、案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge that your family member has agreed and that you would like him to hear the explanation by voice only, without video or recording. Phone participation hasn't been approved yet, so please wait for guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like to ask us about something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない人から、別の人に封筒を渡すよう頼まれました。受け取ってしまいましたが、相手も中身も分からず、そのまま届けるのが不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない人に封筒配達を頼まれ相手中身不明で不安と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A stranger asked me to deliver an envelope to someone else. I accepted it, but I don't know the recipient or what's inside, and I'm worried about delivering it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a stranger asked you to deliver an envelope and that you're worried because you don't know the recipient or the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、その封筒はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the envelope with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、開けていません。受取先の名前が書かれていますが、私の知り合いではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒未開封で宛名も知人でないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I haven't opened it. The recipient's name is written on it, but it's not anyone I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply that the envelope is unopened and you don't know the person named on it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 頼んだ方とは、どこで話しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where did you speak with the person who asked you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅前です。急いでいると言われ、連絡先は聞きませんでした。実際に急ぐ理由は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅前で急ぐと言われ連絡先未確認で理由不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: In front of the station. They said they were in a hurry, and I didn't ask for their contact details. I don't know why they were actually in a hurry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you were told in front of the station that the person was in a hurry, didn't get their contact details, and don't know the reason. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここへ来るまで、どなたかに渡そうとしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before coming here, did you try to hand it to anyone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。宛名の人を探して突然訪ねるより、まず相談しようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未配達で宛名人を突然訪ねず先に相談したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. Instead of looking for the person named on it and visiting them unexpectedly, I thought I should ask for advice first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you haven't delivered it and came for advice before visiting the named recipient unexpectedly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状況を確認します。頼まれた言葉と、覚えている外見をお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the circumstances. Please tell us what the person said and what you remember about their appearance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。覚えている範囲を話します。私も事情を理解した届け役だったという言い方にせず、知らないまま受け取った経過を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記憶範囲で言葉外見を話し理解済み届け役とせず経過を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I'll tell you what I remember. I won't describe myself as a courier who understood the circumstances; I'll explain how I accepted it without knowing what was going on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the words and appearance you remember and explain what happened without presenting yourself as a courier who already understood the situation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 事情を知らずに受け取ったという経過として承りました。封筒を渡す前にご相談いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've noted that you accepted it without knowing the circumstances. Thank you for consulting us before handing over the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お送りになる物について何かご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have a question about something you'd like to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へ手作りのカードを送りたいです。開くと花が立ち上がるので、薄い封筒に押し込まずに包む方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 立体の花が開く手作りカードを押しつぶさずに包みたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send a handmade card to a friend. Flowers pop up when it's opened, so I'd like advice on packaging it without forcing it into a thin envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about packaging a handmade pop-up flower card without crushing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 閉じた時にも、飾りの厚みが残りますか。無理に押さえず、今の状態を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the decoration still have some thickness when it's closed? Please show me its current condition without pressing it down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 閉じてもこの花の部分が少し浮きます。折り目はありますが、平らになるまで押すと花びらが曲がりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 閉じても花が浮き無理に平らにすると曲がりそうだと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Even when it's closed, this flower part sticks up a little. There are fold lines, but pressing it completely flat looks like it would bend the petals.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply that the flower still sticks up when closed and forcing it flat might bend it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飾りを押さえつけない入れ物を探す必要がありますね。お手元に使えそうな箱はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to find a container that won't press down on the decoration. Do you have a box you might be able to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家に小さい箱があります。今持っている封筒は使わず、箱の中でカードが動かないようにできるか試してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封筒は使わず家の小箱でカードが動かない包み方を試すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a small box at home. I won't use the envelope I have with me; I'll try to see whether I can keep the card from moving inside the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll avoid the envelope and try packaging the card in a small box at home so it won't move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 固定する際も、花の部分に直接テープを貼らないように考えてください。受け取る方は仕組みをご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: When securing it, please also consider how to avoid applying tape directly to the flowers. Does the recipient know how the card works?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 初めて見ると思います。開く方向を短いメモで伝えますが、メモを花の間に挟んで引っかからないように別に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開く方向のメモは花に引っかからないよう別に入れると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I think this will be their first time seeing it. I'll include a short note showing which way to open it, but I'll put it separately so it doesn't get caught between the flowers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll place a note about the opening direction separately so it won't snag on the flowers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 包装ができてから、大きさと重さに合う発送方法を確認できます。今日このまま発送されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once it's packaged, we can check a shipping method suited to its size and weight. Will you be sending it as it is today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は持ち帰ります。箱に入れてゆっくり開閉を確かめてから持って来ます。梱包できただけで飾りが必ず無傷で届くとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は持ち帰り箱に入れ開閉確認後に持参し無傷の配達は保証と思わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take it home today. I'll put it in the box and gently check that it opens and closes before bringing it back. I won't assume that simply packaging it guarantees the decoration will arrive undamaged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll take it home today, check opening and closing in the box before returning, and won't assume damage-free delivery is guaranteed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は梱包のご相談として承りました。花の部分を押さえず、箱とメモを整えてからお持ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've handled this as a packaging consultation today. Please prepare the box and note without pressing on the flowers, then bring it in. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。順番待ちでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having difficulty with the queue?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の手続きに付き添う家族が、別に番号を取っていました。用件は一つなので、二つの番号をどう扱えばよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一用件に付き添いも番号を取り二枚の扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: A family member accompanying me for my procedure took a separate number. We only have one matter to handle, so I'd like to ask what we should do with the two numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what to do with two queue tickets when an accompanying family member also took one for the same procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人がそれぞれ手続きをするのではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you aren't each carrying out a separate procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。手続きは私だけです。家族は説明を一緒に聞きたいだけで、自分の用件はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手続き本人だけで家族は説明同席希望と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. The procedure is only for me. My family member only wants to listen to the explanation with me and has no separate matter to handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply that only you need the procedure and your family member just wants to join the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二枚の番号を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you show me both numbers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。先に呼ばれた方を選んで二つとも残すのではなく、不要な一枚を受付へお返ししたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二枚を示し先呼出選択用に残さず不要一枚を返すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. Rather than keeping both and choosing whichever is called first, I'd like to return the unnecessary ticket to reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the two tickets and say you want to return the unnecessary one, rather than keep both to choose whichever is called first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この一枚でお待ちください。付き添いの方も、呼ばれた時に一緒に来られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait with this ticket. Your companion can come with you when your number is called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族が別の窓口で同じ説明を始めないよう、一つの番号で一緒に待つと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一番号で一緒に待ち家族が別窓口で説明しないよう伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll tell my family member that we'll wait together with one number so they don't start giving the same explanation at another counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll tell your family member to wait together under one number and not explain the same matter at a different counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 途中で別の用件ができた場合は、改めて相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If another matter comes up while you're waiting, please ask us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は一つの手続きで一枚を使います。番号を二枚持つことが、手続き二件あることにはならないと理解しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一手続き一枚で二枚所持は二件用件の意味でないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. Today we'll use one ticket for one procedure. I understand that holding two tickets doesn't mean we have two procedures to handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll use one ticket for one procedure and understand that two tickets don't mean two separate matters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日はお客様一人の手続きを、一枚の番号でお待ちいただく形と確認できました。不要な一枚は受付で受け取り、付き添いの方もご一緒に案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed that today you're waiting with one ticket for your own procedure. Reception will take the unnecessary ticket, and we'll guide your companion together with you. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族のメモに「無」とだけ書いてあります。無糖なのか無塩なのか分からないので、このまま商品を選ばないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族メモの無が無糖無塩か不明で選択前に確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family's note only says “no.” I don't know whether it means no sugar or no salt, so I don't want to choose a product without checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to check before choosing because you don't know whether “no” in your family's note means unsweetened or unsalted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品の名前は書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the product's name written on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ヨーグルトと書いてあります。ただ、商品名が分かっても家族が何を省略したかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ヨーグルト名はあるが省略の意味は未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says yogurt. But even knowing the product name doesn't tell me what my family member left out of the note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply that the note says yogurt, but the meaning of the omitted word is still unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書いた方に確認できるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be best to check with the person who wrote it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話します。店員さんがよく使う言葉を当てはめるより、書いた家族の希望を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店員の推測より書いた家族へ電話で希望確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll call them. Rather than filling in a word that shop staff commonly use, I want to ask the family member who wrote it what they want.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll phone the family member who wrote the note to confirm their wishes, rather than rely on a shop assistant's guess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認ができたら、表示を見てお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you've checked, please read the label to choose the product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族に聞くと無糖のことでした。メモの「無」を全部同じ意味とせず、ヨーグルトの糖の表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無糖との返事を受け全ての無へ流用せず糖表示を見ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family member said they meant unsweetened. I won't treat every “no” on a note as meaning the same thing; I'll check the sugar information on the yogurt label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the reply confirmed unsweetened, and you'll check the sugar label without applying that meaning to every “no.” Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの表示にあります。容量の希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's shown here on this label. Do they have a preferred size as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さい物を二つと言われました。無糖であることと個数も確かめ、別のメモの略語はその都度家族に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小二つ無糖を確認し他略語は各都度家族へ聞くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: They said two small ones. I'll check that they're unsweetened and confirm the quantity, and I'll ask my family about other abbreviations each time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll confirm two small unsweetened ones and ask your family about other abbreviations individually. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの商品をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take a look at this product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。遊具で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there a problem with the playground equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが順番を待っていますが、水を飲ませるため一度離れたいです。戻った時に元の位置へ入ってよいか、勝手に決めず確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水分休憩で列を離れ戻る位置を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is waiting in line, but I'd like to step away once so they can have some water. I'd like to check whether we can return to our original spot instead of deciding that ourselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to leave the queue for a water break and check where to rejoin afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは、離れた場合は最後尾から並び直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, if you leave the queue, please join again at the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。次の人へ順番を譲り、戻る時に前へ入らないと子どもにも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後尾条件を理解し次へ譲り前に戻らないと子へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I'll give our turn to the next person and tell my child we won't go back in front when we return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand the back-of-the-line rule, will let the next person go ahead, and will explain to your child that you can't return to the front. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 休憩は通路を空けた場所でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please take your break somewhere that leaves the passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチで飲ませます。列のすぐ横で場所を取ったまま休むのではなく、一度列を離れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチへ移り列横で場所を保持したまま休まないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll give them water on a bench. Instead of resting right beside the line while keeping our place, we'll leave the queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll go to a bench rather than rest beside the queue while keeping your place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでお願いします。お子さんは、また並ぶことを理解していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Does your child understand that you'll need to queue again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今、説明しました。遊具をやめるのではなく、水を飲んでからまだ遊びたければ最後尾へ戻ると話しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子へ休憩後遊びたいなら最後尾と説明したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've just explained it. I told them we're not giving up on the equipment; after drinking water, if they still want to play, we'll go to the back of the line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you've told your child that if they still want to play after the break, you'll rejoin at the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻られた時には、受付が続いているかもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you return, please also check whether people are still being admitted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。休憩後も必ず乗れると約束せず、受付中なら最後尾へ並びます。まず水分休憩にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩後受付確認して利用を保証せずまず休むと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't promise my child that they'll definitely get a turn after the break. If admission is still open, we'll join the back of the line. We'll take a water break first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll check admission after the break without guaranteeing a turn and will rest first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ごゆっくり休んでください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別の車両にいた家族が、一つ前の駅で降りてしまいました。私はこの駅にいます。お互いに動いて行き違わないよう、合流を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族が前駅で降り自身現駅にいて行き違い防止の合流相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family member, who was in another carriage, got off one station before this one. I'm at this station. I'd like advice on meeting up so we don't both move and miss each other.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help meeting up without crossing paths because your family member got off at the previous station and you're at this one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 家族の方とは今、連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you contact your family member now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話できます。家族がこちらへ向かうと言っていましたが、私も戻ると二人がすれ違いそうなので、まだ移動していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通話可で互いに動くとすれ違うため自身未移動と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can call them. They said they were coming here, but if I go back too, we might pass each other, so I haven't moved yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply that you can call and haven't moved because you might pass each other if both of you travel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まずどちらが待つか決めてください。あなたは、この駅のどこにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: First decide who will wait. Where are you in this station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 改札の外の案内板前です。家族には駅名だけでなく、改札の外で待つことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 改札外案内板前を駅名とともに家族へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm in front of the information board outside the ticket gates. I'll tell my family member not just the station name, but also that I'm waiting outside the gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your family member the station name and that you're in front of the information board outside the ticket gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移動する方の列車は、現在の案内で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person who travels can check current information about the trains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では私はここで待ち、家族が移動することを電話で確認します。二人とも相手の返事を聞いてから行動したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自身待機家族移動を双方返事で決めてから動くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll stay here and confirm by phone that my family member will travel. I'd like both of us to hear the other's reply before acting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll decide that you wait and your family member travels only after both have heard and agreed to the plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認後、家族の方に案内を確認してもらってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: After confirming that, please have your family member check the travel information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。私が戻らないことと、待つ場所を伝え、家族の到着予定は本人の確認が済んでから共有します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻らない旨待機地点を伝え家族自身確認後の到着予定を共有すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I'll tell them that I won't go back and where I'll wait, and we'll share their expected arrival time after they've checked it themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply that you'll explain you aren't going back, give your waiting location, and share the arrival estimate after your family member has checked it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お客様はこの駅の改札外の案内板前で待ち、ご家族が移動する方針ですね。電話で双方の了解を確かめてから、ご家族に列車の案内を確認していただいてください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: So the plan is for you to wait in front of the information board outside this station's ticket gates while your family member travels here. Please confirm mutual agreement by phone, then have them check the train information. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが地域の活動について質問したいそうです。私が代わりに参加申込みと言いそうになりましたが、まず本人が聞きたいことを話せるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子の質問を親が申込希望へ替えず本人の質問を支援したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child wants to ask about a community activity. I nearly asked to sign them up on their behalf, but I'd like to let them say what they want to ask first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to support your child's own question without changing it into a parent's application request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 質問だけでも大丈夫です。どんなことを知りたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's fine to just ask questions. What would they like to know?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どんな道具を使う活動か知りたいそうです。参加するかはまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 知りたいのは道具で参加未決定と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: They want to know what tools are used in the activity. They haven't decided whether to participate yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply that they want to know about the tools and haven't decided to participate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、ご本人が話せるよう少し待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I'll give them a little time so they can speak for themselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。子どもは、絵を描く活動なら何を使うのか知りたいと言っています。本人の質問としてお伝えし、まだ言えない所だけ手伝います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもが絵を描く活動で使う道具を知りたいと本人の質問として伝え言えない所だけ手伝う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. My child says they want to know what they would use if it's a drawing activity. I'll pass that on as their question and only help with the parts they can't say yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present your child's question about the tools used for drawing as their own question, helping only with what they can't yet say. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この活動では紙と色鉛筆を使って絵を描き、できた絵を見せ合います。その内容と道具が載った資料もあります。お持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this activity, we draw with paper and colored pencils, then show each other our finished pictures. We also have a leaflet explaining the activity and tools. Would you like to take it home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。本人と家で読んでから参加を考えたいです。今日資料を受け取るだけで申込み済みにはならないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料持帰り検討で受取のみは申込済みでないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We'd like to read it together at home before considering participation. Just accepting the leaflet today doesn't mean we've already applied, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you'll take the leaflet home to consider participation and receiving it alone doesn't constitute an application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料のお渡しと申込みは別です。申込方法は最後のページにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Giving out the leaflet and accepting an application are separate. Application instructions are on the last page.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもが知りたい道具の話を聞き、家で資料を見ます。参加希望が決まったら改めて申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具を聞き家で検討し希望確定後に別申込すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. We've heard about the tools my child wanted to know about, and we'll look at the leaflet at home. Once they decide they want to participate, we'll apply separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply that you've asked about the tools, will consider it at home, and will apply separately once participation is decided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料はこちらです。今日はお申込みとしては受け付けていません。お子さんとご覧になってからご検討ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the leaflet. We haven't accepted an application from you today. Please look through it with your child and consider it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you here to check in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約に遅れて着きました。バスに乗り遅れたためです。遅れた理由を症状が急に悪くなったこととして受け取られないよう、状況を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: バス乗遅れの予約遅刻を症状悪化とせず説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've arrived late for my appointment because I missed the bus. I'd like to explain what happened so my reason for being late isn't taken to mean my symptoms suddenly worsened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you were late for the appointment because you missed the bus, without presenting it as worsening symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約時刻とお名前を確認します。相談内容に変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check your appointment time and name. Has the matter you wish to discuss changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談内容は予約時と同じです。今日は移動で遅れただけで、遅れた間に症状が変わったとは話していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談内容同じで移動中変化を述べたわけでないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's the same as when I made the appointment. Today I was only delayed in transit; I haven't said that my symptoms changed while I was late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply that the consultation topic is unchanged and you weren't reporting a change in symptoms during the journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付できるか確認しますので、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait while I check whether we can register you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。予約していたからすぐ診てもらえると思って先に診察室へ行かず、こちらで確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付可否待ち予約ありでも診察室へ先に入らないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I won't go to the consultation room assuming that having an appointment means I can be seen immediately. I'll wait here for confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait for registration confirmation and won't go into the consultation room first just because you have an appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日は順番が変わります。ご案内までお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your place in the queue will change today. Can you wait until we call you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待てます。変更された順番を確認し、元の予約時刻だけを理由に他の方より先に入ろうとはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 順番変更で待てて元予約時刻で割込まないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can wait. I'll confirm the changed order and won't try to go ahead of other people based only on my original appointment time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you can wait in the revised order and won't cut in based on the original appointment time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。問診票に新しい情報があればお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please let us know if there's any new information for the medical questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。体調の変化があれば別に伝えます。今はバスによる遅れと、予約通りの相談内容として受付をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 体調変化は別報告で今は移動遅れと同相談と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. If my condition changes, I'll report that separately. For now, please register me as delayed because of the bus, with the consultation topic unchanged from my booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll report any health changes separately and that for now you're late due to travel and wish to discuss the same matter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日はバスの都合で遅れ、相談内容は予約時と同じと承りました。受付は済み、順番を変更してご案内します。新しい体調の変化は別にお知らせください。ご説明ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've noted that you were late because of the bus and your consultation topic is unchanged from the booking. You're now registered, and we'll guide you in the revised order. Please report any new changes in your condition separately. Thank you for explaining.
